most_similar_reason: Candidate 3 shares the target's most distinctive motif-cluster: primordial amphibious beings sent/descended from the sky who require a watery environment, dive into a body of water, dispense knowledge and life-principles to humanity, and are linked to founding shrines and the first religious authority, closely paralleling the fish-sages who bring civilization and are banished into the primeval waters.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 9 is a single musician-hero's love, underworld descent, and dismemberment story with no group of civilizing sages, no flood or primeval kings, and no watery hybrid teachers of the arts.
